data: Tesla's income from operations fell from $8,891 million in fiscal 2023 to $4,355 million in fiscal 2025, a decline of $4,536 million, or about 51.0%. For context, the intermediate year, fiscal 2024, came in at $7,076 million. Operating income dropped even though revenue was roughly flat to slightly lower ($96,773 million in 2023 versus $94,827 million in 2025), because total operating expenses rose from $8,769 million to $12,739 million, driven largely by research and development increasing from $3,969 million to $6,411 million, while gross profit slipped from $17,660 million to $17,094 million.
